Unmodified. License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (LICENSE, from the tarball); Reserved Font Names Liberation, Arimo.
Used by CadCraft's plot.js (pdf-font.js) to print text outside Windows-1252 in PDFs: subset to the glyphs a drawing
uses and embedded in the PDF (OFL 1.1 lets fonts be embedded in documents; the subset keeps the name Liberation
Sans with a subset tag, as PDF subsetting does).
Fetched 2026-10-20 (0.6.1 FIX-061-PDF-CHARS).
